description.value: Admiralty Point Lands is a nature reserve on Indian Arm in the Belcarra area of North Vancouver, part of the broader Belcarra Regional Park managed by Metro Vancouver. The waterfront lands offer coastal forest and shoreline habitat. Despite the OSM name crediting Parks Canada, the area appears to fall under Metro Vancouver Regional Parks stewardship.

With no working website content and minimal OSM tags, all amenity fields must be null.
